spoken: Before Dyson's bagless vacuum conquered living rooms, he built 5,126 that failed. He wanted a vacuum cleaner that would not lose suction. Prototype after prototype for five years. Manufacturers still rejected the one that worked. Bags paid their bills. So he stopped asking permission. He sold the machine himself. It became a massive success.
